title: feat: implement DeepRacer PWA with NN visualization and reward design
body:
Implements the DeepRacer PWA as specified in `deepracer/idea.txt`, integrating the car simulation engine from `neurodrivera` and the neural network visualization from `softevo7` into a single zero-dependency PWA.

### Simulation Engine
- Elliptical 24-waypoint circuit with inner/outer boundary walls
- 12 agents with 5-sensor raycast, each controlled by a 5→6→2 neural network (tanh hidden, tanh/sigmoid output)
- GA with elite selection (30%), single-point crossover, Gaussian mutation with generational decay

### NN Visualization
- Real-time per-frame rendering of the best agent's network activations
- Nodes colored by activation polarity (cyan positive, red negative) with glow at >0.5
- Edge thickness/color proportional to weight magnitude (blue positive, red negative)
- Numeric activation values (2 decimal places) rendered inside each node

### Reward Function UI
- **SIMPLE mode**: 6 sliders (CENTER, SPEED, SMOOTH, PROGRESS, HEADING, SURVIVE) with immediate effect
- **CUSTOM mode**: JS code editor using `new Function()` with validation, error display, and 5 preset templates
- `params` object exposes 10 variables matching the DeepRacer API surface (`distFromCenter`, `trackWidth`, `speed`, `steerAngle`, `progress`, `headingError`, `steps`, `lapProgress`, `allWheelsOnTrack`, `isReversed`)

### Files
- `deepracer/index.html` — Single-file PWA (~39KB, all CSS/JS inline)
- `deepracer/manifest.json`, `deepracer/sw.js` — PWA plumbing
- `deepracer/icons/` — App icons (copied from neurodrivera)
